_comment: Generated corpus for the Jira strikethrough grammar. Produced by scripts/generate-strikethrough-corpus.py and rendered through a live Jira Server 9.12 wiki renderer (POST /rest/api/1.0/render); 'struck' is whether that renderer emitted a <del>. The model in lib/markup.py is a deliberate SUPERSET: it may predict a span Jira would not draw (cost: one redundant \-, which prints as a plain hyphen), and the cases where it does are listed in known_over_predictions. known_under_predictions are the shapes it misses; all of them glue a URL or link macro directly to another with no separating character, which prose does not do. Both lists are pinned by tests/test_strikethrough.py so neither can grow unnoticed.
